faces.name: Felonious Rage
faces.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. When that creature dies this turn, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.

faces.name: Felothar the Steadfast
faces.oracleText:
Each creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
Creatures you control can attack as though they didn't have defender.
{3}, {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness, then discard cards equal to its power.

faces.name: Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan
faces.oracleText:
Trample
Whenever Felothar enters or attacks, you may sacrifice a nonland permanent. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

faces.name: Felothar, Rights and Wrongs
faces.oracleText:
Menace, trample, lifelink
Will of the council — At the beginning of combat on your turn, starting with you, each player votes for war or peace. For each war vote, put a +1/+1 counter on Felothar. For each peace vote, you draw a card and lose 1 life. Felothar attacks a player who voted for war this turn each combat if able.
